plain_description.what: Fits item response models (Rasch and 2PL) to the 18 models' right/wrong answers on six benchmarks, measures how saturated each benchmark is, and checks whether the 10% most discriminating items reproduce the full ranking. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Shows which benchmarks still separate today's models and whether a small item subset is enough.
plain_description.information: Shows saturation per benchmark relative to these 18 models. Result: the discriminating 10% does not keep the ranking (tau 0.88 vs bar 0.90, descriptive-only; 0.92 under the alternative MATH scorer); GPQA still separates the top models more than MMLU-Pro.
